Source questions:

## Behavior and boundaries

Describe the trigger, resulting behavior, ownership, and unsupported paths.

## Validation evidence

Exact commands, environment/SDK, observed results, sanitized logs, and tests not run:

## Risk and recovery

Threats, failure paths, migration/recovery or revert plan:

## Independent review (lead-owned)

Link functional and security/reliability verdicts; add UX/accessibility/performance for high-risk work. Agent verdicts are distinct from GitHub approvals. Author cannot approve their own work.
